    About Zcash

    Zcash is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency that uses zero-knowledge proofs (zk-SNARKs) to allow fully shielded transactions. Like Bitcoin, it has a maximum supply of 21 million coins.

    Where this ZEC price comes from
